page.overview:
What is Dragon Scars?

The Dragon Scars is a dungeon located in the Babil Region of Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy, accessible from The Rainbow Shore. It is first visited in Chapter 10, "Too Warm a Welcome".

;Scar 1 Contains a Gate near the dungeon's exit back out to The Rainbow Shore in the south.

;Scar 2 A Red Dragon sitting atop its nest can be found here, guarding a treasure chest.

;Scar 3 Two Red Dragon encounters are found here, one of which blocks access to the Secret Scar. A Gimme Golem blocks access to the main path of the dungeon.
